h1: Custom Cup Minimums Explained: Product and Logo Orders
lead: BOOM uses model-specific order quantities; we do not offer a blanket zero-minimum custom-cup promise. Most products start at 500 pieces and selected products start at 10.
html:
What a no-minimum search does not establish

Finding a no-minimum search result does not make every cup, color or printing process available in any quantity. Use the selected product and the printed color count to identify the order scope.

Your practical low-quantity route

Choose a listed product and send the required quantity. Printed logos follow the 250, 1,000 and 2,000-piece color thresholds; blank products and laser projects are different supply scopes.
